cta_sentence: If you want to stop guessing for good, every temperature, cure time and pour window that prevents these failures is laid out in my e-book, The $3 Luxury Candle:
body: I inspected 50 failed candle batches that real makers sent me — sinkholes, wet spots, frosting, weak scent — expecting 50 different problems. Instead, ONE mistake showed up in almost every batch: guessing the temperature instead of measuring it. In this video I show you exactly how that one invisible mistake causes four completely different-looking failures, and the simple, roughly ten-dollar fix that solves all of them at once.
more: Candice has been making small-batch soy candles for over a decade. Every week I break down one real candle-making problem in plain English — no fluff, no expensive gear, just what actually works. Subscribe and tell me in the comments which of the four failures you've been fighting.
